    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choices_Check" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOrderingChoices" targetRef="Task_CheckItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ItemsMissing" sourceRef="Task_CheckItems" targetRef="Gateway_ItemsMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ItemsAvailable" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsMissing" targetRef="Task_ProvideInstructions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No needed items are missing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ItemsMissing" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsMissing" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsOption"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOption" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Needed items can be borrowed or bought cheaply from friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFriends" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOption" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_FriendsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsMerge_Buy" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buy_Instructions" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_ProvideInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructions_Repair" sourceRef="Task_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairWorked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairNotWorked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The repair did not work</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Selected" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Send a review</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video_Selected" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoSplit" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Send a video</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_EndReviewVideo" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoJoin" targetRef="End_ReviewVideoSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expert_End" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Repair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SmartphoneOwner" name="Smartphone owner" processRef="Process_SmartphoneRepair"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_SmartphoneRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/smartphone-repair">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SmartphoneRepair" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Repair">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SmartphoneOwner" name="Smartphone owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Repair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ContactFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContactFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FriendsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyRemainingItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairPhone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewVideoSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendVideo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewVideoJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendToExpert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Reviewed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_SentToExpert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OnlineTool" name="Online tool">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideMaterialsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideToolsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideOrderingChoices</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OfferFriendContact</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideInstructions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Repair" name="Start DIY repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterDetails" name="Enter phone model and what is broken"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideMaterialsList" name="Provide materials list"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideToolsList" name="Provide tools list"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideOrderingChoices" name="Provide ordering choices for each part"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_OfferFriendContact" name="Offer option to contact friends"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckItems" name="Check which items are already available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about items?" default="Flow_SkipFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendsMerge" name="Merge friend-contact paths"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy remaining items"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideInstructions" name="Provide instructions for fixing the phone"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Fix the smartphone screen"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewVideoSplit" name="Send a review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendVideo" name="Send a video of the repair"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewVideoJoin" name="Merge review and video paths"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send phone to an expert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Reviewed" name="Review and/or video sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SentToExpert" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Enter" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_Materials" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Task_ProvideMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Tools" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_ProvideToolsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tools_Choices" sourceRef="Task_ProvideToolsList" targetRef="Task_ProvideOrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choices_FriendOption" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOrderingChoices" targetRef="Task_OfferFriendContact"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendOption_Check" sourceRef="Task_OfferFriendContact" targetRef="Task_CheckItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ContactDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckItems" targetRef="Gateway_ContactFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactFriends" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The owner chooses to contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipFriends" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Buy" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buy_Instructions" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_ProvideInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructions_Repair" sourceRef="Task_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Worked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotWorked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The repair did not work</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendReview" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The owner sends a review</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendVideo" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoSplit" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The owner sends a video of the repair</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewVideoJoin" targetRef="End_Reviewed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expert_End" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Repair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SmartphoneOwner" name="Smartphone owner" processRef="Process_SmartphoneRepair"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SendToExpert" name="Send phone for expert help" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a system performs or provides multiple distinct functions or outputs: Model each stated function or provision as a separate activity, rather than combining them into one generic activity or omitting them.
rules.situation: the description states that a system performs or provides multiple distinct functions or outputs

rules.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant enters information or other inputs as a distinct action: Model that action as a separate activity in the appropriate sequence; do not omit it or absorb it into another activity.
rules.situation: the description says a participant enters identifying information or describes a problem before a system provides a response based on that input

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome and identifies its action or condition

rules.instruction: When the description says a person is told how to perform a procedure and later indicates whether it succeeded: model the person performing that procedure as a manual task after the guidance and before the outcome is assessed
rules.situation: the description says a person is told how to perform a procedure and later indicates whether it succeeded
